label: PF Backlog 91
title: Backend: consolidate multiple idea entries -> analyze/review -> outcome
body: Intake can deliver IDEAS with no target project. Add: idea-only storage + lifecycle (new/review/parked/promoted/merged); CONSOLIDATION - select multiple idea entries and merge/analyze into one outcome (a consolidated idea, a project brief, or a backlog item). Uses core/insight_extractor + conversation/idea stores; produce a consolidation report. Pairs with dash:ideas-workspace.

dashboard_impact.reason: intake lifecycle surface exists (intake follow-up + parked management)
